findings.description: Marie Philippine Kaÿser, wife of Theodore Hochhertz, died in July 1780 (about 25 July; buried 26 July 1780), recorded in a Luxembourg church register. The death must be dated to July 1780 at month precision or finer — a year-only 1780, or a range reaching outside July 1780, does not satisfy this. The place is Luxembourg; no parish is established.
